title: A showcase-navigation apply refused on its first call is logged as nothing written, not as partly hidden menus
steps: S1: node --test packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/wordpress-quickstart.test.mjs packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/joomla-contract-bind.test.mjs — showcaseNav.apply answers {ok:false,error:'contract_failed'} on its first call (the second-language guard), then the same refusal after one running answer
expect: S1: first-call refusal — one '!! showcase navigation:' line naming the plugin's refusal and ending 'nothing was written, the template showcase stays in the menus'; no 'partly hidden' or 'revert did not' text; no showcaseNav.revert call; the contract inspect still runs last; settled as 'failed — …' and the receipt removed, on WordPress and Joomla
S1: refusal after a running answer (or a lost one) — still reverted, and a failed revert still says 'apply stopped part-way and the revert did not complete — the menus may be partly hidden'
evidence: dev 25/10/2026, Tracy Business wp7 with Claude Cowork WP 0.18.32: showcaseNav.apply refused with contract_failed ('This site already has a second language… Nothing has been written.') and the provision logged 'apply stopped part-way and the revert did not complete — the menus may be partly hidden'
fence: only a refusal on the first apply call, with no answer before it, lost or running, is read as nothing written

tests: a new site has its template showcase taken out of the menus; skips, losses and refusals are said
an apply refused on its first call wrote nothing
a refusal, an ok that is not true over HTTP 200, or a stall is said, reverted, and the pairing goes on
